mil3.4.7:0.3: The Question on Whether the Earth Rests on Water
mil3.4.7:1.3: ‘that the great earth rests on water, that water rests on wind, that wind rests on space,’ that statement too I do not believe.”
mil3.4.7:1.4: The elder took some water in his hand and held it up to King Milinda—
mil3.4.7:1.5: “Just as, Great King, this water is held up by the wind, so too is that water held up by the wind.”
